newsitem.title: INDIA: INSTANT VIEW - India Reliance bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - India Reliance bonus issue.

text.p: Bombay stocks powered ahead after leading private firm and market-favourite Reliance Industries announced a bonus share issue in the ratio of one share for every one share held.
By 1400 hours (0830 GMT) the benchmark Bombay 30-share index rose almost one percent to 4,132.0. Reliance share was up 12 rupees at 378.50, a gain of 3.3 percent
Following are market comments on the news -- KETAN JHAVERI, CHIEF DEALER AT KOTAK SECURITIES, THE INDIAN AFFILIATE OF GOLDMAN SACHS
"Since morning, the market was talking about a one for one bonus share ratio. The announcement is in line with market expectations.
BRIJ GOPAL DAGA, CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER (MARKET OPERATIONS) AT UNIT TRUST OF INDIA
"I think a liberal bonus was expected, but it'll still augur well for the market. Coupled with news of the cut in interest rates, the market should take it positively.
We saw a bit of fireworks in the market today before the Reliance news, however sentiment remains firm."
